description: Cut a PDF into several: one file per page range you name, or equal parts of N pages. Returns each part and a ZIP of all. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Document tools: Work with PDFs and scans: read the text out of a PDF with page numbers and metadata, recognize the text in a scan, photo or screenshot, merge PDFs, take or reorder pages, split into parts, and turn images into a PDF..

every.description: Or cut into files of this many pages each (1 = one file per page).

ranges.description: One output file per entry, each a page list like "1-3" or "4,7-9".
